title: DisplayServer.window_set_postion not respecting Primary Display for multi monitor setup (Windows 11)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible on v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]



### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.23033.1002) - AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 61.65 GiB memory

### Issue description

DisplayServer.window_set_position moves the window to Display 1 regardless of whether display 1 is not the current screen or primary display

Additional Information:

DisplayServer.window_get_current_screen() gets Display 1 regardless of it not being the primary display
DisplayServer.get_primary_screen() gets Display 1 regardless of it not being the primary screen

Workaround, Pass the screen index field of DisplayServer.get_screen_count() - 1, Seems to properly work as intended when centering the window in Display 1 or Display 2

### Steps to reproduce

Repro steps:
In windows 11: 
Set up a 2 or more monitors. 
Hit detect to see which monitor is Monitor 1 and 2
Set monitor 2 as the Primary Display

In Godot:
Create a scene with a functional button.

In the script 
```gdscript
func _on_button_pressed():
        var screen_index: int = DisplayServer.window_get_current_screen()
	var screen_size: Vector2i = DisplayServer.screen_get_size(screen_index)
	var window_size: Vector2i = DisplayServer.window_get_size()
	var centered_position: Vector2i = (screen_size - window_size) / 2.0
	await get_tree().process_frame
	DisplayServer.window_set_position(centered_position, screen_index)
```

Run the project, make sure the window is in the primary screen
Press the button

Result:
DisplayServer.window_set_position moves the window to screen 1 which is default index 0 in this case.
